in_sanskrit.name: देवी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shakti or divine energy of the universe, especially that manifested in the form of a goddess

in_marathi.name: Devi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess, Divine Mother
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devi is the Hindu goddess of fertility, motherhood, creation, and destruction. She is the embodiment of power, love, and compassion. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as the mother of all beings and the eternal source of the universe. Devi represents the divine feminine and is revered as the ultimate protector and nurturer.
